title: Cost of Sensors for Detecting Water Leakages in Water Supply Pipelines
what_it_is: Cost of Sensors for Detecting Water Leakages in Water Supply Pipelines

sections.label: PUB water monitoring system
sections.summary: The system lets PUB monitor hydraulic and water quality parameters via real-time alerts on irregular pressure, flow and water quality data.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The system enables PUB to monitor relevant hydraulic and water quality parameters, through real-time alerts on irregular data patterns in water pressure, flow and water quality which may potentially affect supply to customers.

sections.label: Pipeline checks and sensor network cost
sections.summary: PUB checks pipelines yearly, uses acoustic loggers, records about six leaks per 100 km yearly, and the sensor network costs around $9 million.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: PUB conducts physical checks of its pipelines at least once a year and also deploys portable acoustic leak noise data loggers to aid leak detection.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: Together with our on-going pipeline replacement programme, this results in Singapore experiencing only about six leaks per 100 km of pipes per year, which is among the lowest incidence in the world.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: The cost of developing the entire sensor network system, including the 320 sensor stations and the data analytics software, is around $9 million.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for the Environment and Water Resources (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for the Environment and Water Resources)
sentences.text: PUB envisages that the cost of further expanding the sensor network to more parts of Singapore will be lowered as sensing technology improves, and as the initial investment in software development is spread over a larger base of sensors.

sections.label: Reservoir water loss product evaluation
sections.summary: PUB has looked into products such as applying a product to reservoir water surfaces to reduce water loss, but evaluation found it very expensive.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: My understanding is that PUB has looked into this and some of the products available − for instance, to apply a product to the water surface of the reservoirs to reduce water loss.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But in undertaking an evaluation on the cost effectiveness, my understanding is that it is very expensive.

sections.label: Sensor network expansion plans
sections.summary: PUB found the sensor network enhanced operations and reduced valve-operation incidents, so it will expand deployment to newly laid, limited-coverage, NEWater and industrial water pipelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: PUB has found that the sensor network system has been able to enhance its operations and substantially reduced incidents like valve operations that can lead to a disruption in water supply.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Therefore, it is going to expand the deployment of this sensor network system to cover other parts of the network, which would be the newly laid pipelines as well as pipelines where there is limited coverage and in the next two to three years to also cover the NEWater and industrial water pipelines.
